free_tier.stated: No free tier; a prepaid balance with a USD 10 minimum top-up. First SSH creates the account from the key fingerprint.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not an object

retention.stated: Parked (stopped) boxes keep their disk and a memory snapshot at USD 0.50/month per x1 slot; boxes auto-stop when the balance drops below USD 5 and are deleted at USD 0. Unused funds are refundable within 3 months.

egress.terms: Not metered on the page read: no traffic allowance and no per-GB price is stated; the box gets a public IPv6 address and a managed HTTPS endpoint.

interface_detail: SSH to shellbox.dev for control commands (create, list, duplicate, keepalive, cron, funds) and SSH to a box; scp, sftp and mosh work

limits.value: prepaid balance only; boxes auto-stop below USD 5 and are deleted at USD 0

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: No card, no email, no signup form: 'your SSH key fingerprint is your account'. Payment is a prepaid Paddle balance with a USD 10 minimum top-up, refundable within 3 months; no card is stored by Shellbox. No hold.

reliability_note: Stopped boxes resume from a memory snapshot in about 3 seconds; auto-stop and deletion are triggered by the prepaid balance, not by time.
